name: Asagao Kinema
description: A cinematic, bold and Japanese-modern events theme for a one-screen independent cinema in a fictional town. Shu vermilion #EB6101 covers the hero, the page heads, the intertitle cards and the ticket stub (always with sumi ink text), a sumi film strip runs under it, tokiwa green carries the membership band, and washi paper is kept for reading; Antonio, a tall condensed display, over Chivo. The pictures are sumi-e ink paintings with vermilion washes (raster WebP); in the hero a cut-out ink projector wound with morning glories breaks out of the vermilion band onto the film strip. A fixed sumi top bar (H6) holds the name, the programme dateline in ruled cells, the menu and a ticket button, with a sprocket edge. The home page is a horizontal scroll strip (L4): a giant headline with a vertical (tategaki) label on the edge, then the week as a film strip that scrolls sideways (stills alternate with vermilion and green intertitle cards), the prices on a vermilion ticket stub, a green membership band and the journal. The Programme page lays the same week out as a contact sheet. The footer rolls like end credits (F9). Pages: Programme, Visit & tickets, Membership, About, Journal, Newsletter and Contact. The programme, the ticket prices and the dateline are synced patterns, edited once.
illustration: sumi-e ink with vermilion washes; cut-out break-frame projector

fonts.role: display: headings, the top bar, the menu, day numerals, prices and credits
text: body, leads, notes, tables and captions

summary.zh-TW: 單一影廳獨立電影院網站：大面積朱色配墨與常磐綠、水墨插畫，本週片單做成可橫向捲動的膠卷。
summary.en: A site for a one-screen independent cinema: big vermilion bands with sumi ink, ink-wash pictures and the week as a sideways film strip.
summary.ja: 一館一スクリーンのミニシアターのためのサイト。朱と墨の大胆な配色、水墨画の絵、今週の上映を横に流れるフィルムで案内します。
summary.fr: Un site pour un cinéma indépendant à une salle : vermillon et encre sumi, lavis à l'encre et la semaine en pellicule qui défile.
summary.de: Eine Website für ein Programmkino mit einem Saal: Zinnoberrot und Sumi-Tusche, Tuschebilder und die Woche als seitlicher Filmstreifen.

deviation: v1.1.0 redesign (user feedback 2026-10-15: same layout as Yoru Chocolate and Tsuba Millinery, dull colours). Codes changed from H5/F10/L12 to H6 (fixed top bar with ruled cells) + F9 (end-credits colophon) + L4 (horizontal scroll strip); the combination is unused. Archetype horizontal scroll strip, unlike Yoru (tategaki vertical scroll), Tsuba (editorial magazine) and Kumotori (scene map). Hero cut-out break-frame object: a transparent-background ink projector overlaps the edge of the vermilion band and the film strip below. Palette (user correction: no tetsukon/yamabuki or any blue, since Yoru uses those): shu vermilion dominant, sumi, washi, tokiwa green accent. Contrast: Shu #EB6101 with sumi #1C1C1C text 5.07:1 (shu is never a text colour on washi: 3.04:1, marks and large type only; shu on sumi 5.07:1 for accents in the bar, strip and credits); sumi on washi #F7F3EA 15.39:1; tokiwa #007B43 with gofun #FFFDF7 text 5.27:1, tokiwa as text on washi 4.84:1; deep shu #A84200 links on washi 5.51:1; quiet nezumi #5B5650 on washi 6.56:1; kinari #E6DFCF quiet text on sumi 12.84:1; gofun on sumi 16.75:1. Fonts Antonio + Chivo, OFL-1.1 without a Reserved Font Name, unmodified upstream variable TTFs, used by no other theme. Illustrations: sumi-e ink with vermilion washes (raster WebP via scripts/grok-image.sh), different from the 1.0 risograph and Tsuba's 1.1 etching. Palette slugs keep their 1.0 names for compatibility with stored content.
